text: DSH Plugin Marketplace 是面向 DSH Web 的插件发现与反馈插件，并提供配套命令行工具。它在侧边栏展示可搜索的插件来源和索引摘要，并注册工具供 agent 查询索引、查看插件、准备安装命令、起草问题与社区报告及查看问题状态。用户可在 Web 界面把安装提示写入当前对话输入框，再自行检查；也可使用 CLI 查询、准备安装或处理反馈。适合希望在 DSH 中查找插件并整理安装或社区反馈的用户。访问在线索引与反馈服务需要网络连接。

DSH Plugin Marketplace helps DSH users discover plugins in a searchable Web sidebar or CLI. It shows index summaries, inspects source records, prepares editable install prompts, and supports issue and community feedback drafts. Online index features connect to DSH Index.

DSH Plugin Marketplace 的功能「搜索插件来源」：在 Web 侧边栏打开市场并输入关键词，界面向索引 API 请求匹配来源，同时可显示当前索引摘要和来源链接。
DSH Plugin Marketplace 的功能「准备安装提示」：选择一个来源后，界面把可编辑的安装提示加入当前对话输入框；插件只准备提示，不在此处执行安装。
DSH Plugin Marketplace 使用前须知：查询和提交报告草稿会访问 dshindex.dev API，提交内容会随请求发送到该服务。
DSH Plugin Marketplace 使用前须知：GitHub 或 Gitee issue 操作需要对应用户凭据；提交 issue 会将标题和正文发送到所选托管平台。

@dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace README · What it is：[DSH Index](https://dshindex.dev) is a public index of DeepSeek Harness plugins, built from the GitHub [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic. **DSH Plugin Marketplace** brings that index into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): browse and inspect plugins, install them with your explicit confirmation, and report back to the community.

It runs inside DeepSeek Harness as a plugin, and ships the same capabilities to the `dsh-index` CLI.

@dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace README · Installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The package ships a host plugin, a Web client bundle, and the `dsh-index` CLI in one bundle.

@dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace README · In the CLI：The same typed client powers the DSH tools and the `dsh-index` CLI:

```text
dsh-index doctor
dsh-index plugins list --query "git" --tag workflow --cursor <cursor>
dsh-index plugins summary
dsh-index plugins show owner/repo

The CLI is an interface to the same policy-enforced library, not a route around consent. In Harness, the equivalent abilities are model-callable tools whose side-effecting calls go through the normal user-approval policy.

@dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace README · Trust & consent by design：- A `dsh-plugin` topic match is a **discovery candidate**, never a compatibility or safety claim.
- Every install is a user-confirmed handoff — there is no background install.
- Issue drafts are redacted before submission; tokens, secrets, source files, and raw transcripts are excluded by default.
- Scores and reports stay private until the author opts in and DSH Index approves them.
- Issue polling is local and conservative, using conditional reads and backoff.

@dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace README · Relationship to DSH Index：| Product | Responsibility | It does not do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [DSH Index](https://dshindex.dev) | Public discovery, daily snapshots, observed movement, and moderated community reference | Certify a repository, audit security, or recommend an installation |
| Marketplace | DeepSeek Harness action layer: search, inspect, user-confirmed install, issue drafts/status, and contributions | Silently install packages, silently file issues, or publish raw user data |

@dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run check   # build + 100% coverage tests
```
